text: ### Task 6: Surface the Person observer sheet

comments.text: Unlike Tasks 1–4, which name the exact file to create or entry to merge, Task 6 says only "Deliver the entity's standard observer sheet" without naming the concrete artifact or mechanism — an implementing agent cannot tell whether this means adding an observer descriptor entry, registering a sheet against `people.Person`, or generating a file at a specific path. Rewrite the description to name the deliverable (e.g. "add the observer sheet descriptor entry for `people.Person` at <path>, reading and writing the entity's standard fields") so the change is verifiable.
